cns.text: Marchesa is entertaining her longtime business partner Ervos Trax at dinner in her mansion in Paliano when he announces that he is going to have her killed, because his network is moving into the High City and she is his only obstacle.
He walks her through why a direct attack or poisoning would fail, then reveals that he has poisoned himself so that one of them would have to die.
Marchesa admits she planned to have him killed two nights later, praises his play, and leaves to summon her butler, who has already dug a hole for the body.

cn2.text: Marchesa is crowned Queen of Paliano by the Custodi the day after Brago's death, and she tells Adriana that the Custodi accepted a legal will naming her heir, having dealt with Brago's descendants earlier and paid Kaya to kill Brago.
She proclaims herself Brago's designated heir, disbands the post of Captain of the Guard under her own command, and warns that treason will be met with the harshest punishments.
Adriana spits in her face and answers with a speech calling the queen a usurper and murderer who forged Brago's will.
Leovold concludes that her persona as mother of assassins was a distraction and the throne was always her target, as she replaces the city guard with loyal spies and assassins.
